question: Why is everything established as pure in the teaching of the Vīrāvali?
premises: Everything that has attained identity with consciousness is pure.
This is stated in the glorious Vīrāvali.
The Vīrāvali teaches the discernment of pure and impure.
inference: Because all things share identity with consciousness, they are established as pure in the Vīrāvali's discernment.
uncertainties: The exact text referred to as śrīmadvīrāvalau is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: All things that have attained identity with consciousness are therefore established as pure. This is said in the glorious Vīrāvali, in its teaching on the discernment of purity and impurity.
